## Personality

Frank Stockley is known for having a lot of dash and go. Described as a sport, he is also noted to be less good-looking than [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)_
